LanguageData.FH_Trait_Acidic.label: acidic
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Acidic.description: This fleshbeast ruptures in a burst of acid when it dies.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_BoneSpurGrowth.label: bone spur growth
LanguageData.FH_Trait_BoneSpurGrowth.description: This fleshbeast grows excess bone spurs, reducing the cooldown of its abilities.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Cancerous.label: cancerous
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Cancerous.description: This fleshbeast regenerates like a ghoul, but its control decays much faster.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Degraded.label: degraded
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Degraded.description: This fleshbeast's nervous tissue has degraded, reducing its consciousness.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Domesticated.label: domesticated
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Domesticated.description: This fleshbeast is more stable under hive control.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_ExpandedCapacity.label: expanded capacity
LanguageData.FH_Trait_ExpandedCapacity.description: This fleshbeast can hold additional parasite mass.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Fragile.label: fragile
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Fragile.description: This fleshbeast's body is unstable and takes more damage.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_RapidGrowth.label: rapid growth
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Robust.label: robust
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Robust.description: This fleshbeast hits harder in melee.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Runaway.label: runaway
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Runaway.description: This fleshbeast is prone to breaking free of control after fusion.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Sharp.label: sharp
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Sharp.description: This fleshbeast's sharp natural weapons pierce armor more easily.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Split.label: split
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Split.description: This fleshbeast splits into a small fleshbeast when it dies.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Swift.label: swift
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Swift.description: This fleshbeast moves with abnormal speed.
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Tough.label: tough
LanguageData.FH_Trait_Tough.description: This fleshbeast has a dense, resilient body and takes less damage.
